# Pulse

> Open-source market intelligence for the Solana and Robinhood Chain trenches. Records every launch, runner and death, scores wallets and KOLs, classifies tech versus meme, writes a daily Telegram newsletter, serves a dashboard and an MCP server, and keeps a Postgres archive for training trading bots.

## Docs
- [Getting started](https://nirholas.github.io/pulse/docs/getting-started.html): install and first run
- [API reference](https://nirholas.github.io/pulse/docs/api.html): every JSON route
- [MCP server](https://nirholas.github.io/pulse/docs/mcp.html): tools for agents
- [Data model](https://nirholas.github.io/pulse/docs/data-model.html): every archive table
- [How it works](https://nirholas.github.io/pulse/docs/how-it-works.html): lifecycle statuses, classification, wallet scoring
